description: Block validity in both activation regimes. Each case is one block (hex of Block::to_wire_bytes; big blocks as `block_parts`, the concatenation of each part's hex repeated `repeat` times) at header height `height` under the `activation_height` (`activation_source` as in tx_vectors.json), connected on a parent state whose UTXO view holds exactly `prevouts`. Scope `full`: decode, the structural rules, the hardening block rules, the pow limit (`pow`: `skip` = not checked, `limit` = bits decode and the target is within the pow limit of the height, `full` = also the GnB-SMH proof), the context-free MoneyRange / encoding limits, then the connect-time rules (BIP30, every transaction, coinbase value). Scope `connect`: decode, then the connect-time rules only. Header-chain context (parents known, height = max parent height + 1, expected bits, timestamps) is not part of these vectors. Format: docs/testing/VECTORS.md.
